commits.summary: own bounded PSD/PSB reader (4 compressions, layers, groups, resources, merged composite), byte-exact writer, typed loss report
Folio import proposal (hierarchy, linear-light Pigment tiles, appearance sidecar, loss, provenance), edit-loop apply, Observe report (pushed by another lane's push)
PSD blend keys to Pigment StudioBlendMode, merged-image oracle helper (placeholder never an oracle)

pass is a group pass-through flag (LayerAppearance.pass_through), leaf pass is a typed loss (pass_through_on_leaf_layer), raw key preserved; all 28 PSD keys map to Pigment StudioBlendMode, unknown keys are typed loss never Normal

writes Folio appearance fields (opacity/fill percent, StudioBlendMode discriminant, clipped, isolation, mask coverage tiles); sidecar renamed LayerExtras (raw blend key, clbl/infx/knko, group key, mask default colour); unknown or leaf-pass blend => psd_raster_unmapped unsupported layer

capabilities_done: header + color mode (all 8 modes) + color-mode-data bytes kept
image resources: byte-exact blocks, ICC 1039, untagged 1041, version info 1057 (hasRealMergedData) -> MergedStatus Real|Placeholder|Unknown

layer records: rect, channel table, blend key kept verbatim (28 known keys, unknown => None + typed loss, never Normal), opacity, clipping, flags, mask data view, blending-ranges view, Pascal + luni names, tagged blocks byte-exact with padding
group hierarchy from lsct (type 1/2 folder, 3 bounding divider) via PsdDocument::tree
compressions 0 raw, 1 PackBits RLE (PSD 2-byte / PSB 4-byte row counts), 2 ZIP (zlib via miniz_oxide), 3 ZIP+prediction (8-bit; 16/32-bit implemented but UNVERIFIED)
PSB (version 2): 8-byte section/channel lengths, wide tagged keys, Lr16/Lr32/Layr layer-info blocks
merged composite decode (all compressions) + MergedImage::to_rgba8 + merged_oracle_rgba8 (None when hasRealMergedData=0) as self-check oracle input
typed loss report (kind + fixed code + index/key path) with hand-written JSON; adjustment/fill/text/smart-object/effects/vector keys labelled from the spec key tables
write_psd: unmodified document re-emits byte-identical (PSD and PSB/Lr16); layer rename regenerates luni + Pascal only

to_proposal: Folio snapshot via folio::inspect_bytes (hierarchy, group mix ops with bottom-first ordinals, hidden flag -> visible, canvas artboard), 8-bit RGB/gray pixels -> linear-light rgb_f32le + straight f32 alpha Pigment tiles (256 grid, sRGB EOTF, sparse), appearance sidecar (opacity, blend key + Pigment StudioBlendMode, clipping, clbl/infx/knko), layer_map, provenance (sha256, icc hash, assumed profile)
edit loop: Snapshot::rename -> ImportProposal::apply_to_document -> write_psd -> read_psd, only name/visibility change
Observe: report() emits exactly one terminal frame (Success | Failure(Validation|Unsupported|Loss) | Canceled)
limits: input, layers, pixels, decoded bytes, tagged block size/count, name units, resources, group depth; cancellation checks; truncation sweep + byte-flip sweep never panic

Folio appearance: to_proposal now writes opacity, fill_opacity (iOpa), blend_mode, clipped, isolation and StudioMask coverage tiles (coverage_u8 over the layer rectangle, default colour outside the mask rectangle; MaskTileBlob bytes in ImportProposal::mask_tiles)

tests.clippy: clean for this crate (--tests --examples); pre-existing too_many_arguments warnings are in hsk-studio-observe

unverified: layer flags bit 1 SET = hidden (spec text says visible; PhotoCraft psd source and ag-psd/psd-tools behaviour agree on hidden) -> needs a Photoshop-authored fixture
ZIP+prediction for 16-bit (BE word delta) and 32-bit (byte-plane shuffle + byte delta): behaviour-reference only, spec is silent; ZIP being zlib-wrapped likewise
16-bit sample scale (/65535 assumed) for to_rgba8; 16/32-bit and CMYK/Lab pixels are not mapped into tiles in this slice
PSB merged-image RLE uses 4-byte row counts (spec only states this for layer channels)
global tagged-block alignment (pad to 4 outside length) vs layer-level (inside length): parser tries both and stores pad bytes; round trip is exact either way
ordinal 0 = bottom-most child in Folio ordered_composite edges (assumed from PSD file order; Folio fixture does not state direction)

Folio v1 StudioLayer has no opacity/blend/clipping/mask fields: they travel only in ImportProposal::appearance; kind strings psd_adjustment, psd_fill, psd_raster_unmapped and schema_id psd.tagged.<key> are importer-local labels (open vocabulary), need lead naming decision
PSD mask flags bit0 = linked, bit1 = disabled; iOpa = fill opacity (key absent from spec text)
importer-local labels kept per lead decision: kinds psd_adjustment / psd_fill / psd_raster_unmapped, schema_id psd.tagged.<key> and psd.raster, artboard name 'canvas'
next: Photoshop-authored fixtures to settle UNVERIFIED items; ICC conversion of tiles via prism once a profile route exists
dep_requests: miniz_oxide =0.9.1 (with-alloc) and serde_json =1.0.151 (std), both default-features=false, inline in crate manifest, lines appended to dep-requests.jsonl; Cargo.lock not staged
